segments.speaker: Kavita Rawat
segments.text: Good afternoon sab ko. Annual day ki planning shuru karte hain, bas ek mahina bacha hai.

segments.speaker: Deepak Saini
segments.text: Ma'am, date 20 November hi rahegi na? Parents puchh rahe hain.

segments.speaker: Kavita Rawat
segments.text: Haan, 20 November Friday, woh fix hai. Aaj venue aur programme pe baat karni hai.

segments.speaker: Gaurav Nanda
segments.text: Pichhli baar auditorium mein jagah kam pad gayi thi, log gallery mein khade the.

segments.speaker: Farah Siddiqui
segments.text: Haan, aur AC bhi kaam nahi kar raha tha, bachche costume mein pareshaan ho gaye the.

segments.speaker: Deepak Saini
segments.text: Is baar school ground mein karte hain, shaam ko mausam bhi achha rehta hai November mein.

segments.speaker: Kavita Rawat
segments.text: Ground mein lighting aur stage ka kharcha alag aayega, Deepak ji.

segments.speaker: Deepak Saini
segments.text: Ma'am stage ke liye tent wala bhaiya pehle bhi kaam kar chuka hai, rate theek deta hai.

segments.speaker: Gaurav Nanda
segments.text: Main ground ke favour mein hoon, kam se kam baithne ki jagah toh hogi.

segments.speaker: Kavita Rawat
segments.text: Theek hai, decide karte hain, annual day is baar school ground mein hoga, auditorium mein nahi.

segments.speaker: Farah Siddiqui
segments.text: Achha decision hai ma'am.

segments.speaker: Gaurav Nanda
segments.text: Ek suggestion hai, parents se ticket le lete hain, sau rupaye, kharcha nikal jayega.

segments.speaker: Kavita Rawat
segments.text: Nahi Gaurav ji, management fees ke upar extra charge allow nahi karega, complaint aayegi.

segments.speaker: Deepak Saini
segments.text: Haan, pichhle saal PTA meeting mein fees ko leke pehle hi kaafi bahas hui thi.

segments.speaker: Kavita Rawat
segments.text: Ticket wala idea chhod dete hain, entry free hi rahegi.

segments.speaker: Gaurav Nanda
segments.text: Theek hai ma'am, bas ek option bataya tha.

segments.speaker: Kavita Rawat
segments.text: Ab invitation. Pichhli baar printed cards pe kaafi paisa gaya tha.

segments.speaker: Farah Siddiqui
segments.text: Aur aadhe cards toh bachchon ke bag mein hi reh gaye, parents tak pahunche hi nahi.

segments.speaker: Deepak Saini
segments.text: Class groups pe digital invitation bhej dete hain, ek PDF aur ek chhota video.

segments.speaker: Kavita Rawat
segments.text: Haan, is baar sirf digital invitation jayega, printed card nahi chhapenge.

segments.speaker: Gaurav Nanda
segments.text: Chief guest ke liye ek printed card bana lenge, woh alag baat hai.

segments.speaker: Kavita Rawat
segments.text: Haan, woh ek-do card theek hain. Programme pe aate hain. Farah, dance ka kya status hai?

segments.speaker: Farah Siddiqui
segments.text: Class 5 se 8 tak teen group dance honge, par abhi naam final nahi hue.

segments.speaker: Kavita Rawat
segments.text: Naam jaldi chahiye, costume ka order dena hai, tailor time leta hai.

segments.speaker: Farah Siddiqui
segments.text: Main sab class teachers se naam le leti hoon, dance ki final list bana dungi.

segments.speaker: Kavita Rawat
segments.text: Farah, list parso tak de do, Saturday hai lekin half day school hai.

segments.speaker: Farah Siddiqui
segments.text: Haan ma'am, parso tak list aapki table pe hogi.

segments.speaker: Deepak Saini
segments.text: Ma'am yaad rahe, half-yearly exams 2 November se shuru ho rahe hain, practice usse pehle karni hogi.

segments.speaker: Kavita Rawat
segments.text: Haan exams wali date alag hai, practice timetable usi hisaab se banayenge.

segments.speaker: Gaurav Nanda
segments.text: Sound system ka kya? School wala system ground ke liye kaafi nahi hoga.

segments.speaker: Deepak Saini
segments.text: Bahar se rent pe lena padega, do teen vendors se quote lene padenge.

segments.speaker: Kavita Rawat
segments.text: Sound ka quote koi bhi teacher le aaye, jiske paas free period ho.

segments.speaker: Farah Siddiqui
segments.text: Mere paas toh dance ki practice hai, mujhe chhod do.

segments.speaker: Kavita Rawat
segments.text: Koi na koi le aayega, bas agle somvar tak sound ke quotes mere paas hone chahiye.

segments.speaker: Gaurav Nanda
segments.text: Ma'am, chief guest kaun hoga is baar?

segments.speaker: Kavita Rawat
segments.text: Woh management decide karega, unhone do naam diye hain, abhi confirm nahi hai.

segments.speaker: Deepak Saini
segments.text: Parking ka bhi sochna padega, ground use hoga toh gaadiyan kahan khadi hongi?

segments.speaker: Gaurav Nanda
segments.text: Saamne wali gali mein ho sakta hai. Kavita ma'am, traffic police se aap hi baat kar lo, aapki baat sunte hain.

segments.speaker: Kavita Rawat
segments.text: Haan woh main khud dekh lungi, principal ke letter se kaam jaldi hota hai.

segments.speaker: Farah Siddiqui
segments.text: Ma'am refreshments ka kya, pichhli baar samose kam pad gaye the.

segments.speaker: Kavita Rawat
segments.text: Haha, haan yaad hai. Woh canteen wale se baad mein baat karenge, abhi budget aana baaki hai.

segments.speaker: Deepak Saini
segments.text: Photographer bhi wahi purana rakhein?

segments.speaker: Kavita Rawat
segments.text: Haan, unka kaam achha tha, unko hi bulayenge.

segments.speaker: Gaurav Nanda
segments.text: Theek hai ma'am, mere side se sab clear hai.

segments.speaker: Farah Siddiqui
segments.text: Mere bhi, main dance list pe lag jaati hoon.

segments.speaker: Kavita Rawat
segments.text: Chaliye, thank you sab ko. Agle hafte phir baithte hain.

decisions.fact: The annual day is held on the school ground instead of the auditorium.
Invitations to parents go out only digitally; no printed cards.

action_items.fact: Farah collects names from class teachers and prepares the final dance list.
A teacher gets quotes for renting a sound system; nobody named.
Kavita speaks to the traffic police about parking near the ground.

distractors.fact: Charging parents Rs 100 for tickets was suggested and dropped.
2 November is when half-yearly exams start, not the dance list's due date.
